feat: Implement event, featured, and journalism widgets with manifest loading and gallery display

- Added EventWidget component to load and display events from a manifest.
- Created FeaturedWidget component for showcasing featured works with manifest support.
- Developed JournalismWidget for displaying journalism stories with image galleries.
- Introduced Lightbox component for image viewing in all widgets.
- Added types for events, featured items, and journalism manifests.
- Included sample manifest JSON files for events, featured works, and journalism.
\n\nAuthor: mccal
